method: Called the NOAA CO-OPS API (water_level/predictions, 8720218, NAVD, metric, gmt, 6 min), USGS IV (nwis.waterservices.usgs.gov, 02246500, 00060) and IEM directory listings (mtarchive MRMS, mesonet stage4) directly from the built-in browser; check interval = suggested window +1 day on each side; residual = observed − predicted (computed on the fly, not saved); coverage check only, no event data downloaded. USGS values in cfs; NOAA in m NAVD88.
new_this_round: floyd1999 (no NOAA 6min/hourly data, no gridded rainfall)

rain_products.2002-2014: NCEP Stage IV 01h(IEM mesonet archive, 4 km)
rain_products.2001-2011 alt: MRMS reanalysis PrecipRate (radar-only 5 min, not recommended)
rain_products.2012-2014 alt: NMQ Q2 tile2 q2rad_hsr_nc (radar-only, not recommended)

usgs_qualifier_note: 1999/2004 records carry [91] = 'no matching qualifier' (meaningless); all are grade A

events.name: Matthew
events.rg: 10-11 missing 2 h (4 days after peak; exact hours to be confirmed on download)
events.ev: NWS JAX PSH report; Mayport observed 1.59 m, highest before 2017; widespread flooding along the St. Johns River
events.note: MRMS 2 h small gap in event segment

events.name: Ian
events.peak: 09-29 16–20Z (exits to sea from NE Florida after crossing the peninsula)
events.rg: 09-28 missing 1 h (event segment, 1 day before peak); 09-25 missing 1 h (extension segment)
events.ev: NWS JAX PSH report; Mayport residual 1.13 m, >1 m for 5.6 h
events.note: MRMS 1 h small gap in event segment

events.name: Milton
events.peak: 10-10 10–19Z (crosses the peninsula; NE-wind setup in NE Florida)
events.ev: NWS JAX PSH report; Mayport residual 1.05 m
events.note: USGS 60 min small gap in recession segment

events.name: Dorian
events.peak: 09-04 18–21Z (moves north parallel to the coast, nearshore)
events.ev: no NWS JAX post-event report; NHC TCR; Mayport residual 0.93 m
events.note: most complete data; moderate local impact, evidence only NHC TCR + station data

events.name: Beryl
events.rain: NCEP Stage IV 01h (4 km, RFC gauge-corrected; IEM archive)
events.ev: direct landfall on the study area; Hogans Creek flash flood, Fernandina surge 1.14 m, 38,000 customers without power (Wikipedia/NHC)
events.note: rainfall product is Stage IV (not MRMS, 4 km)

events.name: Debby
events.peak: 06-24–26 persistent heavy rain, 06-27 12Z surge peak; Black Creek record flood
events.rain: NCEP Stage IV 01h (4 km; IEM archive)
events.ev: Clay County Black Creek 587 homes flooded, St. Marys River record stage, Orange Park street flooding (Wikipedia/NHC)
events.note: rainfall-dominated event; Stage IV; heavy rain starts 06-24, spin-up segment (06-21–24) nearly dry

events.name: Jeanne
events.peak: 09-27 00–03Z (moves north from NE Florida after crossing the peninsula)
events.rain: NCEP Stage IV 01h (4 km; IEM archive)
events.ev: Mayport observed 1.39 m; 4 tornadoes in St. Johns County; 1 death in Clay County (Wikipedia/NHC)
events.note: Stage IV; 4 NOAA quality-flagged records to be listed

events.name: Frances
events.rain: NCEP Stage IV 01h (4 km; IEM archive)
events.ev: NHC TCR; NE Florida impact mainly prolonged rain and wind
events.note: Stage IV; 3 weeks apart from Jeanne, elevated river baseflow

events.name: Eta
events.peak: 11-12 landfall at Cedar Key, exits to sea near Jacksonville the same day; 11-15 13Z water-level peak
events.ev: NHC TCR; NE Florida rainfall; Mayport residual 0.6 m

events.name: Isaias
events.peak: 08-03 16Z residual peak (moves north parallel to the coast, offshore)
events.ev: NHC TCR; passed offshore, weak impact

events.name: Imelda
events.peak: no landfall, turned east offshore 09-30–10-03; 10-03 14Z residual peak
events.ev: no NWS JAX post-event report; Wikipedia records no NE Florida impact; residual >0.5 m for 52.6 h may include spring tide + Humberto swell

events.name: Helene
events.peak: 09-26–27 (Big Bend landfall, study area to the east)
events.qest: about 60 records (15 h) with e (estimated) flag
events.note: weak local impact; USGS estimated segments to be listed

events.name: Debby
events.qest: about 60 records (15 h) with e (estimated) flag

events.name: Hermine
events.note: very weak local impact, not recommended

events.name: Nicole
events.qg: 11-13 00:45->11-15 14:30 (61.75 h, 3–5 days after peak, still within the 7-day event segment)
events.ev: NWS JAX PSH report; Mayport 1.69 m, second only to Irma
events.note: strong impact but Acosta missing 61.75 h; cannot be generated with the current workflow without filling

events.name: Fay
events.qg: 08-18 04:45->08-23 05:00 (120 h, covers the entire peak period)
events.note: Acosta missing 5 days in the key period

events.name: Floyd
events.rain: none (Stage IV from 2002, MRMS reanalysis from 2001)
events.note: Mayport has no 6 min/hourly water level; no gridded rainfall
